title: Neuralink plans high-volume brain implant production by 2026
reliability_notes: Reports Elon Musk's stated 2026 production and automated-surgery plan; a declared plan is not evidence that high-volume production was completed.
key_contribution: Dates and preserves the production announcement that opened the session.

title: Two Years of Telepathy
reliability_notes: First-party company update; useful for product state and disclosed performance but not independent validation.
key_contribution: Documents Neuralink's disclosed clinical and engineering trajectory in early 2026.

title: A mixed-signal analogue front-end for brain-implantable neural interfaces using a digital fixed-point IIR filter and bulk offset cancellation
reliability_notes: Engineering paper describing an analog neural-recording front end with amplification before analog-to-digital conversion.
key_contribution: Supports the pre-digitization physical acquisition boundary in implantable neural interfaces.

title: Human auditory system response to modulated electromagnetic energy
reliability_notes: Foundational human experiment; historical apparatus and exposure conditions must be retained when applying results to modern systems.
key_contribution: Establishes human auditory perception induced by appropriately modulated electromagnetic energy.

title: Method and device for implementing the radio frequency hearing effect
author_org: United States Department of the Air Force
reliability_notes: A patent establishes a claimed design and government-assigned engineering work; it does not by itself establish operational fielding or independent performance validation.
key_contribution: Describes preprocessing and suppressed-carrier modulation intended to produce intelligible subjective speech through the RF hearing effect.

title: US Army Philippine Air Force test counter-drone systems at Balikatan 2025
reliability_notes: Official deployment and exercise account; mission focus is counter-UAS electronics rather than human neural effects.
key_contribution: Documents Army fielding and live testing of a microwave beam system that disrupts disables or destroys drone systems.

title: Science and Tech Spotlight: Directed Energy Weapons
reliability_notes: Authoritative public overview; summarizes classes and maturity rather than proving every individual system specification.
key_contribution: Documents HPM power scale graduated effects portability limits and health-policy uncertainty.

title: FarSense: Pushing the Range Limit of WiFi-based Respiration Sensing with CSI Ratio of Two Antennas
reliability_notes: Laboratory research with defined transceiver geometry and processing; does not mean every deployed router performs respiration sensing.
key_contribution: Demonstrates commodity-Wi-Fi CSI respiration monitoring including a through-wall configuration and reported eight-meter range.

title: Wireless Silent Speech Interface Using Multi-Channel Textile EMG Sensors Integrated into Headphones
reliability_notes: Controlled-vocabulary skin-contact EMG experiment; not unrestricted internal-monologue decoding.
key_contribution: Demonstrates headphone-integrated textile EMG classification of ten intentionally produced silent control words at 96 percent accuracy.

title: SilentWear: an Ultra-Low Power Wearable System for EMG-based Silent Speech Recognition
reliability_notes: Wearable controlled-command study; repositioning and inter-session performance remain material constraints.
key_contribution: Demonstrates textile-neckband on-device silent-speech recognition and quantifies cross-validation inter-session calibration latency and power.

title: Ethics of neurotechnology: UNESCO adopts the first global standard in the cutting-edge technology
reliability_notes: Official institutional standard; identifies governance risks and protections rather than proving covert deployment.
key_contribution: Recognizes mental privacy neural-data consent manipulation autonomy and AI-neurotechnology convergence as governance concerns.

title: Restricted canonical source record
reliability_notes: The canonical ledger contains a restricted source record. Its contents and access path are not published in this repository.
key_contribution: Counted for ledger integrity; withheld under the public/private publication boundary.

title: The Convergence Architecture
author_org: Marc Tuinier; MT Tech Industries LLC
reliability_notes: Public synthesis connecting component evidence; it does not substitute architecture-level inference for case-specific integration evidence.
key_contribution: Provides the public subject-level architecture to which the atomic ledger attaches.

title: Apparatus for audibly communicating speech using the radio frequency hearing effect
author_org: United States Department of the Air Force
reliability_notes: A patent establishes a claimed apparatus and engineering disclosure; it does not establish operational fielding range safety or independent validation.
key_contribution: Companion apparatus record for RF-hearing speech communication.

title: Revisiting Privacy Preservation in Brain-Computer Interfaces: Conceptual Boundaries Risk Pathways and a Protection-Strength Grading Framework
reliability_notes: Security and privacy review; organizes threat surfaces and controls but is not itself evidence of a specific compromise.
key_contribution: Defines protected neural objects and risk pathways across collection transmission storage training inference decoded output and feedback.

title: Person-in-WiFi: Fine-grained Person Perception Using WiFi
reliability_notes: Controlled research using exposed Wi-Fi measurements and trained models; deployment performance depends on geometry hardware and generalization.
key_contribution: Demonstrates body segmentation and pose estimation from Wi-Fi measurements across indoor scenes.

title: Non-Contact Vital Signs Detection with UAV-Borne Radars
reliability_notes: Research platform for rescue and security contexts; motion compensation range clutter and validation conditions remain essential.
key_contribution: Demonstrates UAV-borne radar measurement of respiration and heartbeat-related micromotion without bodily contact.

title: A Survey on Millimeter-Wave Radar for Human Sensing
reliability_notes: Survey aggregates research capabilities; individual range accuracy and deployment claims must be tied to the underlying papers and products.
key_contribution: Maps mmWave localization tracking activity vital-sign biometric and imaging capabilities.

title: Design and Experimental Validation of UAV Swarm-Based Phased Arrays with MagSafe- and LEGO-Inspired RF Connectors
reliability_notes: Experimental array concept; does not establish operational military use or arbitrary long-range coherent transmission.
key_contribution: Demonstrates multiple UAV elements forming and steering a combined RF aperture.

title: Scale-Free Beamforming using Swarm Arrays for Remote Sensing under Interference
reliability_notes: Recent formal and simulation work; practical synchronization navigation and hardware constraints require separate validation.
key_contribution: Describes cooperative swarm relays and interference-suppressing beamforming for remote sensing.

title: A Multi-physics Simulation Framework for High-power Microwave Counter-unmanned Aerial System Design and Performance Evaluation
author_org: A. A. Jafari and G. Anbarjafari
reliability_notes: Simulation framework rather than field deployment evidence; modeled ranges and damage outcomes depend on assumptions inputs and validation.
key_contribution: Integrates propagation antenna pointing coupling semiconductor damage stochastic orientation thermal and safety constraints.

title: An Assessment of Illness in U.S. Government Employees and Their Families at Overseas Embassies
author_org: National Academies of Sciences Engineering and Medicine
reliability_notes: Committee assessment based on available clinical and incident information; consistency with a mechanism is not identification of a source operator or universal explanation.
key_contribution: Places directed pulsed radiofrequency energy within the evaluated human-effects mechanism space for distinctive acute incidents.

title: Aerial and Ambient Sensing Extension
author_org: Marc Tuinier; MT Tech Industries LLC
reliability_notes: Controlled public synthesis separates optical radar CSI thermal infrastructural and actuation claims.
key_contribution: Registers the aerial and infrastructural extension and its source boundaries.

title: AIMS Automated Image-Based Monitoring System
reliability_notes: First-party product and maturity claims; independent range accuracy obscuration and operational-performance validation remain separate.
key_contribution: Documents low-SWaP aerial or ground human detection geolocation body-position estimation non-contact vital signs TAK integration and stated TRL 6 maturity.

title: Drones in disaster zones could prove a lifesaver
reliability_notes: Institutional account of a collaborative UAV trial; the reported geometry was approximately three metres and the modality was video rather than penetrating radar.
key_contribution: Documents aerial optical heart and respiration measurement from skin-tone changes and minute head movements.

title: Global Launch of the Lynx6-A Robot Mountable Breathing Detector System
reliability_notes: Company launch announcement; detection conditions independent performance and continued availability require separate review.
key_contribution: Documents a remotely connected breathing and heartbeat detector designed for unmanned-vehicle or small-UAV-assisted survivor search under rubble.

title: Wi-Chat: Large Language Model Powered Wi-Fi Sensing
reliability_notes: Preprint activity-recognition study; does not establish vital-sign extraction identity linkage unrestricted through-wall operation or deployed retention.
key_contribution: Demonstrates physical-model-guided LLM interpretation of CSI for zero-shot human activity recognition.

title: Lightweight Multimodal Adaptation of Vision Language Models for Species Recognition and Habitat Context Interpretation in Drone Thermal Imagery
reliability_notes: Ecological drone-imagery study; it supports RGB-to-thermal model adaptation rather than a human-targeting or physiological-state deployment.
key_contribution: Demonstrates projector-based adaptation of pretrained VLMs to thermal radiometric drone imagery with species and habitat-context outputs.

title: A Resilient and Energy-Efficient Smart Metering Infrastructure Utilizing a Self-Organizing UAV Swarm
reliability_notes: OPNET-based networking and energy study; it does not validate bio-surveillance RF-hearing cognitive actuation or complete convergence closure.
key_contribution: Documents hierarchical UAV-swarm smart-meter collection task reallocation fault tolerance networking and payload-endurance modelling.

title: SIM7600E-H 4G HAT specifications
